features.name: total_cost_score
features.description: Sum of buying and maintenance costs as a combined financial burden indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct split on combined cost burden; high values strongly predict unacceptable ratings

features.name: safety_persons_interaction
features.description: Product of safety rating and passenger capacity as a combined safety-utility score
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nonlinear interaction between safety and capacity; zero when either is zero

features.name: is_low_safety
features.description: Boolean indicator for lowest safety rating (safety == 0)
features.expected_model_benefit: Hard threshold split; low safety is a strong disqualifier for acceptable ratings

features.name: is_low_persons
features.description: Boolean indicator for minimum passenger capacity (persons == 0)
features.expected_model_benefit: Hard threshold split; minimum capacity strongly predicts unacceptable ratings

features.name: high_cost_low_safety
features.description: Boolean indicator for both high combined cost and low safety simultaneously
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures worst-case combination of high cost and low safety for direct tree splitting

features.name: overall_quality_score
features.description: Composite quality score combining safety, capacity, and luggage boot while penalizing cost
features.expected_model_benefit: Single numeric score capturing overall desirability; enables efficient tree splits across quality spectrum

features.name: cost_bucket
features.description: Ordinal bucket of combined buying and maintenance cost into 4 tiers (0=very low, 3=very high)
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal grouping of cost tiers for cleaner tree splits than raw sum

features.name: utility_score
features.description: Combined utility score from doors, persons, and luggage boot representing practical usability
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates practical utility dimensions; higher scores correlate with better ratings

features.name: is_high_safety_high_capacity
features.description: Boolean indicator for both high safety (>=2) and high capacity (persons>=2)
features.expected_model_benefit: Identifies premium safety-capacity combinations associated with good and very good ratings

features.name: cost_to_utility_ratio
features.description: Ratio of total cost to utility score, clipped to avoid division issues; higher means worse value
features.expected_model_benefit: Value-for-money ratio enables nonlinear splits; high ratio indicates poor value proposition

features.name: semantic_comfort_level
features.description: Ordinal comfort level score (0-3) based on combined assessment of doors, luggage space, and passenger capacity as proxies for physical comfort and practicality
features.expected_model_benefit: Semantic grouping of comfort-related features into interpretable ordinal buckets for tree splitting

features.name: risk_adjusted_value
features.description: Holistic value assessment (0-4) considering safety risk relative to cost paid; penalizes high cost with low safety and rewards low cost with high safety
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the risk-adjusted value perception that drives car acceptability judgments beyond simple additive features
